name: settleview_feed_kalshi

query_condition.sql: SELECT stream, min(value) AS v FROM "settleview_stream_stale" WHERE venue = 'kalshi' GROUP BY stream HAVING min(value) >= 1

description: Kalshi feed stale: no fresh message on a Kalshi stream.

context_attributes.slo: Each Kalshi stream fresh 99.5% of minutes (7 days); fires after 3 min stale.
